title: Projection-normalized Roos realization and primitive tensor model
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and its quotient rings [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], a scheme $W$ and its ringed sequence category and total-limit functor $\mathcal L$ [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site], and the coherent reduction/limit calculus $S$ [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data]. Use the strict Roos complex and its projection-normalized comparison [lem-weil-strict-roos-comparison], and the completed tensor on good K-flat representatives [def-pur-integral-operation-complex-models, def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. A Roos realization is a natural isomorphism from the localized strict Roos complex to total derived inverse limit whose composites with all finite projections are the actual Roos projections, and whose value on every K-injective resolution is the Roos resolution map followed by the inverse of the canonical inclusion with zero shifted coordinate. For a proposed tensor realization $v:K\widehat\otimes L\cong\mathcal L(S(K)\otimes S(L))$, define its tensor-model predicate as follows: every pair of good K-flat integral complexes admits simultaneous K-flat quotient-system representatives of its two actual reductions, with every finite component and horizontal transition agreeing with the specified reduction presentation [def-pur-coefficient-reduction-presentation]; their tensor tower comparison is the canonical finite tensor comparison on each component; and the Roos realization of that tower, using the given projection-normalized Roos datum, equals $v$ under these specified comparisons. These are data and predicates, without asserting existence, invertibility of a new map, or a transport theorem. Site and coefficient universes remain independent.
